player_prompt.intro:
I si Jokelani {player_id} kɛ HighSociety (jɛkɔrɔba 2) kɛ.
Jɛkɔrɔba dɔnɔ:  Donso 10 tanu aliba kɛ, sɛbɛn na.
Bido:    Aliba kɛ, a yɛrɛ fɛɛrɛ kɛ 1-11, o kɛ o tɔgɔ.
            • Bido ɲɛgɛnɛ tanba donso kɛ, o kɛ o fɛɛrɛ.
            • Bido kɛrɛnkɛrɛnɛ, o kɛ o fɛɛrɛ.
            • Sɛbɛn -> bido wɛrɛ wɛrɛ, o yɛrɛ tanba donso tɛ se.
Dɔnɔnafɛ:    Aliba wɛrɛ, o kɛ dɔnɔnafɛ + donso tanu.
            Dɔnɔnafɛ ɲɛgɛnɛ tanba (sɛbɛn -> sɛbɛn).

**Aferen dɔnɔ**  →  bido fɛɛrɛ kɛ '[7]' ni '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O ka kan ka [X] wari kariti kelen de fara a kan.
invalid_move.card_not_held: O wari kariti tɛ i bolo tun.

message.tie: Bɛnkanniw bɛ segin. U ka kan!
